why_ai: Screen-based media buying with no licence; ad platforms already automate bidding and creative selection.
why_clarity: Payback and ROAS are measurable targets, but attribution is noisy and value arrives months later.
why_digital: Data in, dashboards and ad platforms for production, digital campaigns out, bought remotely.

why_ai: Listing copy, keyword choice and store tests are generatable and testable by software.
why_clarity: Store conversion rate is a clear metric and store experiments give fairly quick objective answers.
why_digital: Store listings, keyword data and experiments are entirely online work and output.

why_ai: Reconciling four reported install counts has knowable causes and is directly computable by software.
why_clarity: Same weekly reconciliation from known rules, though no ground truth confirms the final allocation.
why_digital: Network reports, measurement data and finance numbers in, an allocation out, all on screen.

why_ai: An information-design optimisation over a few bits that software can search and evaluate.
why_clarity: Chosen once at launch, and whether the schema was good shows only in later model quality.
why_digital: Event data in, a schema configured in measurement tools out, all remote.

why_ai: A statistical attribution problem on aggregated data that modelling software will own.
why_clarity: Dozens of variants weekly, but aggregated attribution makes the true winner hard to verify.
why_digital: Spend and postback data in, creative-level estimates out, entirely digital.

why_ai: A continuously refit forecasting problem with a clear objective, squarely in ML's reach.
why_clarity: Clear target of six-month value, backtestable on past cohorts, repeated every campaign.
why_digital: Postback data in, value predictions fed to bidding out, all software.

why_ai: Geo experiments are systematisable, though an independent trusted measurement keeps some value.
why_clarity: Lift tests have established designs and a measurable answer, but each test takes weeks.
why_digital: Spend and outcome data in, experimental lift estimates out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: A well-posed lifetime value forecasting problem that ML tooling handles directly.
why_clarity: LTV is a defined number, methods are standard, and cohorts confirm it within months.
why_digital: Purchase, subscription and ad revenue data in, forecasts out, all on screen.

why_ai: Both halves, schema design and value prediction, are quantitative problems software will absorb.
why_clarity: Recurring bidding prediction, but delayed, suppressed signals make correctness slow to confirm.
why_digital: Aggregated postbacks in, predictions and bids out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Generative video already produces ad variants at volume; no licence or relationship protects the producer.
why_clarity: High-volume variant production judged by taste, with no feedback on which creative worked.
why_digital: Briefs and assets in, video and playable files made on screen and delivered digitally.

why_ai: Weekly budget allocation is an optimisation that platform automation and software increasingly perform.
why_clarity: Recurring weekly allocation, but disagreeing sources and unscored predictions blur whether it was right.
why_digital: Dashboards and spreadsheets in, budget changes in ad platforms out, all remote.
